name: paper-transition
summary: Two seams that read as paper: fold, the current picture swings away about its left edge like a panel; blot, ink spreads from scattered points and opens onto the next picture with soft edges.
use: st = state(params, u) for u 0 → 1 over the seam; canvas(ctx, st, A, B, params) with A and B full-frame canvases. The book page is components/page-turn.

slots.name: variant
slots.text: fold: a panel swinging away (about 0.85 s reads well); blot: ink opening onto the next (about 1.2 s)

slots.name: ease
slots.text: fold: how the panel swings over u

slots.name: shade
slots.text: fold: the shade on the next picture at the start

slots.name: dark
slots.text: fold: the panel's shade when edge-on

slots.name: blots
slots.text: blot: how many blots; from u = 0.55 a last one from the centre covers the frame

slots.name: seed
slots.text: blot: where the blots are and how big (a new seed, a new pattern)

slots.name: ink
slots.text: blot: the ink edge's colour, r,g,b

slots.name: soft
slots.text: blot: the softness of the opening's edge

sample.text: the contact sheet's moments: the middle of each seam

provenance.note: canvas-film's fold and blot transitions, made engine-free
